title: Social Data Analytics, B.S. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Entrance to major requires a C or better in MATH 140/141/CMPSC 131/132 and a B or better in PLSC 309, not modeled directly (grade-minimum gates the schema doesn't represent). New soda_catalog.json (SODA 308/496); every other course used (MATH 140/141/220, CMPSC 131/132/221/360, PLSC 1/10/309, IST 210, STAT 184/318/380, DS 220) was already fully cataloged from earlier majors -- an unusually clean build for this batch, reusing five different departments' worth of existing data. SODA 496 (Special Topics, max 999cr) is scheduled twice; the second occurrence is a generic repeat slot, matching the WFED 395/ARCH 491 repeatable-course convention. 'PLSC elective' (2 occurrences), 'PLSC 400-level' (4 occurrences), 'DS course' (3 occurrences), 'Advanced Analytics' (3 occurrences), and generic Gen Ed/Writing/Ethics/Speaking pools are modeled as generic slots, matching the bulletin's own open-selection phrasing. 'LA 283' (the same unconfirmed code hit throughout recent Liberal Arts builds) replaced with a generic slot. Several semesters' bulletin-stated credit totals didn't fully reconcile against their itemized course lists (a recurring minor source-summarization gap this session) -- not force-corrected. Post-rescrape real gap found: STAT 184 has a real, literal 'MATH 21' prereq (no OR alternatives) that MATH 140/141 doesn't satisfy -- added the real MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 chain (MATH 21 needs MATH 4, which needs MATH 3), same fix pattern as LSCPE-2026.json. STAT 380's own prereq (PLSC 309/DS 200/STAT 200, already satisfied by PLSC 309, AND STAT 184) resolves automatically once STAT 184 is fixed. Re-verified against the bulletin's own program-requirements PDF (social-data-analytics-bs_programrequirementstext.pdf) for a real handbook-depth pass. Confirmed all Prescribed Courses except the below are present and correctly named. Found 2 real bugs, both fixed: the bulletin's own 'Additional Courses' section names TWO distinct 3cr electives -- 'Select 3 credits from PLSC 3/7N/14/17N' and a SEPARATE 'Select 3 credits from PHIL 106/107/233Z/406/407' (ethics-and-technology elective) -- but this plan had both modeled as the identical generic 'PLSC Elective' placeholder, silently dropping the PHIL-specific requirement entirely. Fixed: Semester 3's item now enumerates the real PLSC 3/7N/14/17N list, and Semester 4's item now enumerates the real PHIL list (added PHIL to departments) -- narrowed to PHIL 106/107/407 since PHIL 233Z and PHIL 406 do not exist in the scraped phil_catalog.json (stale/renumbered bulletin codes, same convention as the RUS 400 pattern). Real gap found and NOT fixed (flagged rather than force-corrected, per instruction to never fabricate): the bulletin's 3 generic-looking 'DS course' requirements in this plan actually correspond to 3 specific Prescribed Courses -- DS 300, DS 310, and DS 330 -- not an open department pool. Wiring them in for real would also require: (a) adding STAT 200 or DS 200 (both gated behind MATH 21, itself already scheduled Semester 3, but neither course is anywhere in this plan) to satisfy DS 300's and DS 330's own first prereq group; and (b) resolving a pre-existing PSU cross-listing data quirk where DS 310's prereq_groups cite the course as literal 'MATH 318' while this plan (and STAT/MATH 318's own cross-listed catalog entry) uses the code 'STAT 318' -- the engine currently treats these as two unrelated codes, so DS 310 would never actually unlock even after STAT 318 is completed. Left the 3 generic 'DS Course' slots in place rather than risk a half-correct fix; noted here for a dedicated follow-up. No PSU Social Data Analytics program handbook (beyond the bulletin) could be found published anywhere -- bulletin-only major.
